featured_reviews.name: deepak rajgar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Best Pure Veg Spot in Neelkanth Business Park!

Lark is my go-to spot whenever I’m at Neelkanth Business Park. It’s a perfect mix of great taste, hygiene, and a professional yet cozy vibe.

Here’s why it’s a must-visit:

Signature Dishes: You have to try the Pineapple Shira—it’s sweet, rich, and has real fruit bits. For snacks, the Lark Special Idli (loaded with dry fruits) and Idli Chilly Fry are absolutely delicious and perfectly spiced.

Multi-Cuisine Variety: Their menu is huge! From authentic South Indian breakfast to spicy Chinese and North Indian Sizzlers, everything is fresh and flavorful. The Kerala Appam with Stew is another hidden gem here.

Cleanliness & Ambience: The restaurant is very well-maintained. The washrooms are clean, and the seating is comfortable enough for a quick lunch or a long team dinner.

Budget-Friendly: Despite being in a premium business park, the prices are very reasonable for the quality and quantity they serve.

Convenience: Located on the ground floor, it’s super accessible for everyone working in the park or coming from Vidya Vihar station.

Verdict: 5/5 for service, taste, and cleanliness. Definitely the best pure veg option in the area!

featured_reviews.name: aakruti dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Tripo Spice, a rooftop place with great ambience, ample seating space, and beautifully designed décor. The overall vibe is lovely and makes for a very pleasant dining experience.
We loved the food — the white sauce pasta was creamy and delicious, the dry Manchurian was flavourful, and the mint paneer was equally delicious. We also tried their special Belgium Brownie milkshake, which was super chocolaty and absolutely indulgent.
The staff is very courteous and polite, adding to the overall warm and pleasant experience.
The only downside was the seating policy — despite calling in advance, we were informed that weekend bookings are not accepted and only walk-ins are allowed. Additionally, they made us wait until all our friends had arrived before seating us, which felt a bit unnecessary.
Overall, it’s a wonderful family restaurant with good food, great ambience, and a well-designed rooftop setting. Definitely worth visiting for the food and ambience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review! We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the rooftop ambience, décor, spacious seating, and of course the food. It’s wonderful to hear that the white sauce pasta, dry Manchurian, mint paneer, and our Belgium Brownie Milkshake made your experience memorable. 😊

We also truly appreciate your kind words about our staff and hospitality.

Regarding the seating policy, weekends tend to be extremely busy, and to ensure a smooth experience for all guests, we follow a complete-arrival seating policy during peak hours. We understand the wait may have felt inconvenient and truly appreciate your patience and understanding.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback and recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you and your friends again soon for another enjoyable rooftop dining experience! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Spoons of Mumbai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Triospice! This place is perfect for a romantic date or a cozy outing with family. The ambience is warm, inviting, and adds beautifully to the overall dining experience.

What really stands out is their extensive global menu — from Indian and Chinese to Italian, Mexican, and fusion dishes, they truly offer something for everyone. Being a pure vegetarian restaurant is a huge plus, and they even have Jain options available for most dishes, which is very thoughtful.

We tried the Crackling Paneer, Loaded Classic Nachos, Aloo Basil Tikka, Tri O Melting Ghotala Sandwich, Triospice Charminar Sabzi with Butter Roti, and Pesto Risotto — and every single dish was delicious. The quality of ingredients and the taste were absolutely top-notch.

Also, don’t miss the sunset here — it’s breathtaking and sets the perfect mood for an early dinner with your loved ones.

Highly recommended! 🌅✨

We’re especially happy to hear that dishes like the Crackling Paneer, Loaded Nachos, Aloo Basil Tikka, Ghotala Sandwich, Charminar Sabzi, and Pesto Risotto impressed you. featured_reviews.name: Rajkumar Sahu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at Bougan Villa for 1 day, and overall it was a really pleasant and comfortable experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff was polite, welcoming, and helpful. The check-in process was smooth, and they guided me properly with all the basic information about the property.
The room was clean, well-maintained, and spacious, with a peaceful atmosphere that made the stay relaxing. The bedding was comfortable, and the room had all the necessary amenities required for a short stay. The washroom was also hygienic and neatly arranged, which is something I always appreciate while traveling.
One of the best things about Bougan Villa is the calm and quiet environment. It feels like a perfect place to unwind, especially if you want to stay away from noise and enjoy a peaceful time. The property is well managed, and everything felt organized.
The location is also good, and it was convenient for me to reach nearby places easily. I also liked the overall vibe of the hotel — it feels warm and homely rather than just a typical stay.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We went to Flavors at Bay near Hotel Hira mainly because it was convenient for us. Unfortunately, the food was a big disappointment.

I understand that it’s a vegetarian restaurant and spices are an important part of Indian cooking, but spices should complement the meal — not completely overpower it. Everything we ordered tasted like it was just packed with masala and nothing else.

We ordered momos, and they were honestly the worst part of the meal. They didn’t taste like real momos at all. Instead of a proper filling, it felt like a dough ball stuffed with pure spices. The taste matched how it looked — just overwhelming masala with no balance. Coming from a Nepali background where we eat momos often, this was really disappointing.

The biryani was the same story. It was mostly spice with very little flavor or balance beyond that.

The service itself was good and the staff were polite. The location was convenient for us as well. However, the restaurant felt quite empty and overall the food experience was not good. Unfortunately, the heavy spices even gave us heartburn afterwards.

We really wanted to enjoy the meal, but it ended up being a very disappointing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Udupi 2 Mumbai in Vidyavihar (East), near the railway station on R.C. Marg, is a stellar pure-vegetarian destination offering authentic South Indian, North Indian, and Indo-Chinese cuisine. Known for its generous portions, hygienic environment, and flavorful dishes like Paneer Makhmali and Veg Club Sizzler, it is a perfect spot for families and students alike.
Located in Sai Vihar Co-op Housing Society, this restaurant is a hidden gem for those seeking delicious, budget-friendly, and quick service. The menu shines with classic Udupi staples, including perfectly crispy dosas, fluffy idlis, and robust sambar that tastes just like the traditional flavors of South India. The ambiance is modern yet comfortable, making it a great spot for a casual lunch or family dinner.
A standout experience highlighted in recent vlogs is the unique, fiery Veg Club Sizzler, which comes highly recommended. Another favorite is the Paneer Makhmali, which is consistently praised for being "soft as butter," making it a must-try for vegetarian lovers. Their menu is extensive, catering to various tastes with options that ensure everyone in a group finds something they enjoy.
The staff is generally attentive and the service prompt, making it convenient for, commuters and local residents near Vidyavihar Station. It provides excellent value for money with high-quality, fresh food. Whether you are looking for a quick, authentic breakfast of idli-vada or a hearty, diverse, multi-cuisine dinner, Udupi 2 Mumbai delivers a reliable and enjoyable dining experience. It is a fantastic, reliable vegetarian eatery in the heart of the eastern suburbs.

featured_reviews.name: Balasubramanian G
featured_reviews.review_text:
In an area that had very few vegetarian restaurants, this one turned out to be a life saver. The small restaurant had great ambience and it had enough options for me to opt to go to this place almost daily during my stay in Mumbai for close to a week.
They mostly serve south Indian options which can also be a rare occurrence within the city.
The food was great and the service was excellent too. A place that is definitely worth considering for a quick and delicious meal.

featured_reviews.name: Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a breakfast experience at Thambi’s Veg Restaurant. I tried the masala dosa and it was absolutely delicious—crispy on the outside with a flavorful potato filling inside. The sambar and chutneys were fresh and complemented the dish really well. Service was quick and the staff were polite. While the food quality is excellent, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side compared to similar places. Still, a good spot for a satisfying South Indian breakfast.

featured_reviews.name: Helen Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stepped in for a quick brunch.

Without much ado I placed order for Andhra masala dosa, modak and coffee. Of course I got help in ordering and that was a delightful experience. Dosa was served quickly, with sambar, coconut chutney and tomato chutney. Food was excellent and I relished every bite.

The restaurant has been tastefully redone and the decor is pleasant. Service is excellent.

A visit is highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sk Sareen
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried the plain dosa here, and it was quite good! 😋 It arrived promptly, accompanied by flavorful sambar and coconut chutney. 🥥 The tea was also very enjoyable. ☕ While the prices were a bit high, the quality of the food made it a worthwhile experience. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Provides variety of south indian dishes that are very authentic. We had the south indian thali,veg biriyani,tea and coffee. Tha south indian thali was great. So was the biriyani. Perfect mix of spices.
Coffee was good but not like authentic south indian probably coz of mumbai coffee taste different than south indian coffee grounds.
Tea was very sweet.
The service was top notch and servers were very friendly.

featured_reviews.name: S N Gokani
featured_reviews.review_text: Thambi Veg Restaurant serves tasty South Indian food with good overall quality. The dosa I tried was really nice—crispy and flavorful. Service was nice and quick. Only downside was pav bhaji wasn’t available at night despite being on the menu. Still a solid experience.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Thambbi is just perfect i honestly can’t complain about anything except the location. The food is incredible, especially the tomato chutney wow. I had the dosa and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting. A must try!

featured_reviews.name: Abinash Mohanty
featured_reviews.review_text:

One of the best🙌

featured_reviews.name: Vansheet Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I just ordered from here and was genuinely impressed by how delicious and flavorful the food was! It arrived fresh and hot, and I especially appreciated the high-quality packaging that kept everything perfectly intact during delivery. It is rare to find such a tasty meal at such a reasonable price point, and the attention to detail from the kitchen really shines through. I highly recommend giving them a try—I will definitely be ordering again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent experience at this veg restaurant with bar. The food quality is outstanding, with a wide variety of vegetarian options that are fresh and full of flavor. The ambiance is pleasant and well maintained, making it a great place for family dinners as well as get-togethers with friends.
The bar is well stocked, and the service is prompt and courteous. Overall, a perfect combination of good food, good drinks, and a comfortable atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Zoraiz Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated a birthday here and it was an amazing experience! 🎉 The decoration was beautiful, the service was quick and very friendly, and the staff made us feel really special.

The food was absolutely delicious and presented so attractively 😍. Perfect place for birthday parties or any special occasion. Highly recommended! ⭐

featured_reviews.name: saumil shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve celebrated my birthday here twice with different groups, and both times the experience was fantastic. Everyone absolutely loved the food! We tried a variety of cuisines—North Indian, Asian, tandoori starters, and Chinese—and everything was delicious and well-prepared.
The ambience and service were also quite good, making it a great place for gatherings and celebrations.
The only drawback is that the washrooms are outside and shared with the entire mall, so cleanliness can be an issue. Also, since the mall is still under construction and escalators are not functional, the first impression isn’t the best.
Overall, a wonderful dining experience, and definitely recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lark - The Veg Bar is a newly opened pure veg restaurant and bar inside R-Odeon Mall on the first floor.
I visited here with my family for a Sunday afternoon lunch. Even before we placed our order, we received a compliementary "Roasted Papad" along with Mint Chutney which was a good touch. Overall, the food was quite good both in taste and quantity, along with being reasonably priced. The service too was prompt despite the place being slightly crowded. The staff was cordial, and happy to give their recommendations if required. Lark is a very good option whenever one happens to visit the mall for movie viewing and/or shopping.
I would surely visit here again in the near future. Kudos to the team!

featured_reviews.name: Sweta Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visiting Lark the veg bar at Ghatkopar East R odeon mall has been a very pleasant experience......the staff is very courteous and polite. Food and service is too good. Special mention for Mr. Vishal, he has been very attentive and at service. Would definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Deeya Nagdev
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s a good restaurant. The food can be better. Starters were good we had Cheese cigar roll & a Paneer starter both were nice . Indian main course was great , Chinese rice was tasty but little spicy pizza was disappointing it was not that tasty felt undercooked. Mocktails were awesome. HARSH was too good , he served amazing Mocktails they were delicious. Falooda was really disappointing it was undercooked and not tasty . Toofani Brownie was tasty but it was not that appealing. Avg food , good aesthetic ambience.
